definition.en: A finished opening in a garment — the slit that lets a head, a hand or a body through, faced or bound so it can be closed again. Where a button stand is the extension a closure sits on, the placket is the opening itself: the two edges, which one laps over which, and how far.
definition.es: Una abertura acabada en una prenda — la ranura que deja pasar una cabeza, una mano o un cuerpo, entretelada o ribeteada para poder volver a cerrarse. Mientras la tapeta de botonadura es la prolongación donde se aloja el cierre, la tapeta de abertura es la abertura misma: los dos cantos, cuál monta sobre cuál y hasta dónde.
definition.fr: Une ouverture finie dans un vêtement — la fente qui laisse passer une tête, une main ou un corps, parementée ou bordée pour pouvoir se refermer. Là où la sous-patte de boutonnage est le prolongement sur lequel s'assoit la fermeture, la patte est l'ouverture elle-même : les deux bords, lequel croise sur lequel, et jusqu'où.
definition.pt: Uma abertura acabada numa peça — a fenda que deixa passar uma cabeça, uma mão ou um corpo, entretelada ou debruada para poder voltar a fechar-se. Onde a carcela de botões é o prolongamento em que assenta o fecho, a carcela de abertura é a própria abertura: os dois bordos, qual monta sobre qual, e até onde.

aliases.name: placket
aliases.note: hyperobject.interfaces[].type value; 41 declared interfaces as of 2026-09-02, spanning front plackets, wrap fronts, and the heritage diagonal closures (changpao and cheongsam-qipao both declare `dajin_closure` here).

constraints: The two edges of a placket are sewn to a body that has to close: the underlap must carry an edge of exactly the overlap's length, measured off the drawn curve rather than computed twice — fashion-cabinet/changpao draws its dajin once and marks the underpanel from the SAME curve, so the two are equal by construction.
